content:
TEMPTATION ||| Slip my fingers from the blade and lean closer ||| “What if I told you I want to be misaligned?”  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hand away, steady the blade between us ||| “This isn’t the time. We need clarity, not chaos.”  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, my breath catching ||| “I feel your weight in this room, and it scares me.”  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tightly, asserting my stance ||| “I’ll answer, but only if you promise to listen.”  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, heart racing, my eyes locked on Julian's ||| *A sharp breath, a moment of stillness.*
